description: The plot illustrates the accuracy of two models, Ex1 Accuracy and Ex2 Accuracy, in predicting the next token in a sequence. The x-axis represents the step number, ranging from 0 to 60000, while the y-axis shows the accuracy percentage, ranging from 0.10 to 0.40. The Ex1 Accuracy line, marked with blue circles and a solid line, starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.10 at step 0 and increases sharply to reach a plateau at around 0.40 by step 10000. The Ex2 Accuracy line, marked with green circles and a dashed line, begins at a similar accuracy level but increases more gradually, reaching a plateau at around 0.35 by step 10000. Both lines show a steady increase in accuracy as the number of steps increases, with Ex1 Accuracy consistently outperforming Ex2 Accuracy throughout the steps.
